title: Internal dimensions from Azad Automotive Customs (approximate)
conversion: Given in feet and inches; converted at 1 in = 25.4 mm and rounded to the nearest mm. The original figures are kept in as_given.
status: Not merged into data/vehicles/<id>.json. Those files remain the source of truth for the eligibility engine and the drawings' living area. This file is used by js/interior.js (usable length, partition, wheel-arch keep-out) and tools/validate_azad_glb.js. Nothing here is verified.

definitions.lengthWithPartition_mm: Internal length measured with Azad's partition wall installed: from the partition's rear face to the inside of the rear door. As given by Azad.
definitions.bareLength_mm: Internal length with no partition: from behind the driver seats to the inside of the rear door. = lengthWithPartition_mm + partition offset. Uses partitionOffsetDefault_mm while partitionOffset_mm is null.
definitions.partitionOffset_mm: How much length the partition takes: from behind the driver seats to the partition's rear face. Azad: about 2 to 2.5 ft longer without it (partitionOffsetRange_mm). null = pending.
definitions.partitionOffsetDefault_mm: 686 mm (27 in, the middle of 2 to 2.5 ft). A temporary default until Azad gives the figure per vehicle.
definitions.width_mm: Internal width as given by Azad. The height at which it was measured, and whether it is inside the trims, is not stated.
definitions.height_mm: Internal height as given by Azad. Floor and ceiling reference surfaces not stated.

wheelArch.height_mm: Height of the arch box above the finished floor.
wheelArch.width_mm: How far the arch box sticks out from the side wall into the cabin.
wheelArch.length_mm: Length of the arch box along the vehicle.
wheelArch.startFromFront_mm: From behind the driver seats (the front of the bare length) to the front edge of the arch box.
wheelArch.note: One value per vehicle, applied to both sides. All null until Azad sends them.

partition.position_definition: position_mm = distance from behind the driver seats (front of the bare length) to the partition's rear face.
partition.usable_length: usable living length = bareLength_mm - position_mm. With the partition where Azad fits it (position = partitionOffset_mm) this gives lengthWithPartition_mm back. With no partition, position = 0 and the usable length is the bare length.

wheel_arch_cover.rule: No separate arch cover is fitted. Whatever furniture is placed over an arch (seat base, cabinet, bed frame, bench) is built around it, and its cover is generated from that furniture (js/interior.js archCover). Seats need a plinth; a washroom needs a flat floor (data/rules.json D-WHEEL-ARCH).
wheel_arch_cover.until_data_arrives: Furniture may not be placed over an arch zone. The keep-out zone is the estimated wheel housing already in data/vehicles/<id>.json (interior.wheel_arch, ESTIMATED, at the rear axle). Views show it as "arch data pending".

vehicles.label: Traveller T2 3350
vehicles.match_basis: Assumed to be the Traveller N Wider Body (exterior 2245 mm). The standard Traveller N is 1925 mm wide outside, narrower than this 2007 mm inside width, so it cannot be that body. Confirm the model name with Azad.

vehicles.label: Traveller T2 4020 DV
vehicles.match_basis: DV is read as Delivery Van (Force sells a Traveller N Delivery Van, see the model list in data/handover/rv_handover_part1_models_data_research/research/oem_snapshots/). The delivery van is not one of the 14 variants, so it is matched to the passenger Wider Body 4020 shell, the only 4020 body in the data wide enough for 2007 mm inside. The Traveller 26 4020 (2225 mm outside) is kept as an alternate.

conflicts.action: Not resolved. Azad's three Urbania lengths differ by 787 and 788 mm, matching the body-length steps (785 and 785), not the wheelbase steps (265 and 785). The 3350 is 1570 mm shorter overall than the 4400, so a body-length derivation gives about 2621, close to Azad's 2540.
